# Document Templates (文档模板库)

This directory contains standardized templates for AI-driven development. Templates serve as operational scaffolds to guarantee structural integrity across documentation.

本目录维护 AI 驱动协作的标准化模板文件，为人机协作提供脚手架。

## Template Index (模板索引)

| Template | Target Path | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [spec-template.md](./spec-template.md) | `docs/specs/<area>/spec-<feature>[STATUS].md` | Working memory for complex tasks (任务工作记忆模板) |
| [rule-template.md](./rule-template.md) | `docs/rules/*.md` | Armed incident museum card (武装化事故规则卡片) |
| [adr-template.md](./adr-template.md) | `docs/adr/*.md` | Architecture Decision Record (架构决策记录) |
| [troubleshooting-template.md](./troubleshooting-template.md) | `docs/trobleshooting/*.md` | Incident investigation runbook (事故排查手册) |
